checks.after: At that time one black dragon and one white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led his officials to observe them from more than two hundred paces away and offered a sacrifice (source wording 祭乙太宰 remains uncertain and is not silently emended).
checks.reason: 去龍二百餘步 is more than two hundred paces away, not ‘within two hundred’; 親 and 觀之 were dropped. The replacement fixes these and flags the anomalous 祭乙太宰 openly instead of naming a ‘great sacrifice’, with no emendation.

checks.after: At the time there were one black dragon and one white dragon, which appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them at a distance of more than two hundred paces from the dragons, and performed a sacrifice (anomalous source wording 祭乙太宰 left unresolved; not read as a grand-boar offering or silent 太牢 emendation).
checks.reason: The literal’s ‘grand boar offering’ quietly imports a 太牢 reading the supplied 祭乙太宰 does not give. The replacement keeps only the sacrifice action, flags the text as unresolved, and fixes the distance phrasing.

checks.after: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people’s field tax.
checks.reason: 丐百姓田租 is the ruler remitting the people’s field rent or tax, not ‘begging off’ (the wrong actor). The replacement keeps 久旱 and 百姓; ‘tax’ versus the pending EN’s ‘rent’ is a valid rendering of 田租, not a defect.

checks.after: Later he saw a white hare, galloped to shoot it; his horse fell and he was injured, then he told what he had seen.
checks.reason: 見白兔，馳射之 is seeing, galloping and shooting; 馬倒被傷 is the horse falling and him being hurt; 乃說所見 is recounting what he saw, not ‘the omen’. The replacement restores each without adding interpretation.

checks.after: He was carried back to the palace in a litter and summoned Jun to entrust him with affairs after his death.
checks.reason: 輦而還宮 is being carried in a litter back to the palace, and 引俊屬以後事 is summoning Jun and entrusting him with affairs after his death, not ‘briefing him on the succession’. Faithful, and the existing Jun label is only retained.

checks.after: He returned to the palace in a litter and summoned Jun, entrusting him with affairs after his death.
checks.reason: ‘Led Jun to entrust later affairs’ reverses who entrusts whom; 引俊 is summoning Jun, and 屬以後事 is entrusting him with them. The replacement keeps 輦 and 宮 and states the actor correctly.

checks.after: When Murong Jun assumed the imperial title in usurpation, he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wenming.
checks.reason: 俊僭號 is Jun usurping the imperial title, which the source marks as illegitimate, not simply ‘took the throne’. The replacement keeps 僭 and 追諡, and the existing father label is only retained, not newly approved.

checks.after: You can at a hundred paces set up a blade; if my shot hits, you then should turn back;
checks.reason: In 吾射中者, 中 is the verb ‘hit’, not the noun ‘center’, and 便宜反 is ‘you then should turn back’ rather than ‘conveniently’. The replacement is faithful and keeps the speaker’s conditional.

checks.after: To wish to live in proud reclusion and wait for a great opening is to wait for the Yellow River to run clear.
checks.reason: 偃蹇考槃 is proud reclusion and 以待大通 is waiting for a great opening; ‘hide and wait for peace’ thins both. The replacement matches the pending reviewed literal and keeps the 俟河之清 comparison.
